_readme: ROW 2026 London's budget, as data. Read ONCE by the 'Seed ROW 2026 budget' action in
Settings, which writes it to budget:<projectId>. After that, storage is the source of
truth and this file is never read again — the budget is edited in the app.
A SECTION is a display bucket: {id, name, expectedCode, phaseSet}. phaseSet is 'shoot'
or 'post' and names one of the sets in db:budget_settings.
A LINE is {id, crewId, section, code, item, name, days{}, rate, vatRate, floatPercent,
bbcOverride, notes}.
crewId       null on most lines (suppliers, locations). A pointer only — rate and VAT
are COPIED at the moment of linking and never re-read from the crew record.
section      the section id this line displays under.
code         the code it COUNTS under on the top sheet. May differ from its section's
expectedCode; where it does, the line is flagged in the app, information only.
days         phase name -> number of days, e.g. {"Shoot": 6}.
floatPercent null follows the project's floatPercent below; 0 means this line carries
no float at all, and is a real stored value, not 'unset'.
bbcOverride  '' derives the BBC category from the rules table; a letter beats the rules.
daysTotal, total, vat, float, totalWithFloat and the resolved BBC category are DERIVED
on every read and must not appear in this file.
*** THIS FILE HAS NO LINES IN IT YET. *** The ROW 2026 line data was not supplied with
the Phase AV brief (the prompt's paste placeholder was never filled in), so the sections
and lines arrays below are empty and the Settings action deliberately refuses to seed an
empty budget. Paste the real sections and lines in and it works with no code change.
Expected once seeded: subtotal 318669, fee 31867, total 350536.
